- Public sidecar attach flow documentation now explains attach, discovery,
  candidate review, approval, evidence collection, fresh gate runs, status reads,
  next prompts, and proof-strength outputs.
- README, QUICKSTART, and COMMANDS now distinguish candidate proof surfaces,
  approved proof surfaces, fresh gate runs, and last-known status reads.
- ProofSurfaceMatcher now has strong phrase routing for build, test, deploy,
  and visual readiness language.
- Adversarial matcher tests cover docs-only deploy mentions, package test script
  existence, screenshot path existence, seed-gold overclaiming, SYNC_ALL script
  existence, wrong-repo command output, Codex-reported build success, and
  candidate-only surfaces.
- The GitHub-facing hardening audit artifact now exists at
  docs/audits/STAX_RED_BLUE_HARDENING_AUDIT.md.

What is weak/provisional:
- The hardening audit records an external reviewer score around 0.91; it is a
  reviewer assessment, not a formal STAX release score.
- The public attach doc is documentation only; more real observer runs are still
  needed to measure false accept and false reject behavior.

What is unverified:
- GitHub Actions status for this new commit until it is pushed.
- Public-user comprehension of the attach flow by a person who has not seen the
  repo before.

Risks:
- Proof-surface matching can still miss unusual wording until more observer runs
  convert misses into regression fixtures.
- The repo still has complexity debt and archived report surface area that should
  be compressed later rather than expanded.

One next action:
- Run STAX sidecar gate, then commit and push this focused public attach and
  adversarial matcher patch if the gate accepts.
